metadata.notes: === MANUAL ACTION REQUIRED === After import: (1) Rebind Airtable connection on modules 4 and 7 to SSS PAT. Base = appdZ49WqgjRXxA1R, Table = Bookings (tbl72omPibBkn2hZL). (2) Replace PASTE_OPS_LOGGER_ALERTER_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE in module 8. (3) === STRIPE SETUP REQUIRED === In Stripe Dashboard > Developers > Webhooks: Add endpoint using THIS scenario's Make webhook URL. Select event: payment_intent.succeeded only. Copy the webhook signing secret and store in your credential vault. (4) === STRIPE TEST MODE === In Stripe Dashboard, ensure you are in TEST MODE during initial testing. Use Stripe's 'Send test webhook' feature to verify this scenario works before going live. SAFETY GATES: Module 3 blocks any event that is not payment_intent.succeeded. Module 5 blocks if booking not found or already DEPOSIT_PAID (idempotency). Module 6 blocks if Environment = Sandbox. AIRTABLE FIELDS WRITTEN: Status=DEPOSIT_PAID, Stripe_Payment_Intent_ID, Deposit_Amount, Last_Automation_Timestamp. NOTE: If Bookings table does not have Stripe_Payment_Intent_ID or Deposit_Amount fields, create them before activation.
